name: Connect to Power Query data sources and create paginated reports using PBI Report Builder
description: Create print-ready paginated reports in Power BI Report Builder by connecting to over 100 data sources using the Get Data experience. You can transform and load Leverage parameterized, paginated reports functionality from PBI Report Builder with 100+ data sources by connecting using Power Query. Create pixel-perfect, print-ready paginated reports using data sources such as Snowflake and Databricks without requiring ODBC or an on-premises data gateway, and publish them to the Power BI service.

result.nameEs: Conectar con orígenes de Power Query y crear informes paginados con Power BI Report Builder
